bands.provenance: diagnostic bands, NOT registered criteria. The upper line is §11.8's smallest effect of interest, which is the registered scale on which a change in compliance matters.

capital_word_note: Every segmentation-drift change in this corpus is CR6, whose numerator is `capital_word`. That is not the U+0130 effect §7.3's correction is scoped to: a fold-then-segment word list is lower-cased, so a case test over it reads zero for every answer. The drift does not misread `capital_word` subtly --- it destroys it. On the other fourteen numerators fold-then-segment changes no verdict at all in 30,720 responses, which is the registered scope claim holding empirically. `capital_word` is also the one numerator new in v4r3 with no carry-over evidence, which §10.2 already requires to earn its own; this is a second reason it should.

purpose: Gate 1 measurement robustness. Read-only. It rescores stored responses under the six registered alternative readings and changes nothing.
reads: load 0 and load 1 rows only; no composed cell enters

stored_verdict_check.meaning: the verdict stored at generation time against the verdict this hash computes now. A disagreement means the amendment moved a number that had already been measured
